title: In Vitro Angiogenesis Assay
author: Germán Alberto Téllez Ramírez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ju3cnyn
materials: La células se deben sembrar hasta una confluencia de 80% (Generalmente sembrar 5 x 10 5 (500.000) a 1 x 10 6 (1’000.000) células por cada recipiente de 25 cm 2 ). Medio de cultivo (DMEM 1X, Antibiotico antimicotico 1X, piruvato de sodio 1mM, suero fetal bovino 10%, factores de crecimientos para celulas endoteliales 500ng/mL) Esta línea celular no debe exceder 12 pases. Las células deben ser pasadas al menos dos veces después de ser descongeladas de nitrógeno líquido. DMEM, powder, high glucose Gibco - Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #12100046 EA.hy926 (ATCC® CRL-2922™) ATCC Catalog #CRL-2922 fetal bovine serum eurobio Catalog #CVFSVF0001 Sodium Pyruvate (100 mM) Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #11360070 Antibiotic Antimycotic Solution (100×), Stabilized Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #A5955 Pituitary Extract bovine Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #P1167-5MG

Pasar el extracto de membrana basal del congelador de -80°C a 4°C un día antes de realizar del ensayo. El extracto de membrana basal se gelifica muy fácilmente, por lo tanto es importante no calentarlo como parte del proceso de descongelación y mantenerlo en hielo mientras se pipetea en las placas de cultivo celular. Este puede ser alicuotado y congelado a -20°C o -80°C o almacenado a 4°C por pocos días. Invertir el tubo con el extracto varias veces antes de alicuotar. Cultrex® 3-D Culture Matrix™ Reduced Growth Factor Basement Membrane Extract, PathClear® Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #3445-001-01

Posterior a las 24 horas de incubación, adicionar 50 μL/pozo de Calceina AM (Ref. C3100MP, Invitrogen) a una concentración final en el pozo de 6 μM e incubar nuevamente por 30 minutos. 00:30:00, Incubar la placa con Calceina AM

steps.title: Coat plate with basement membrane extract
steps.instruction: Thaw a tube of basement membrane extract (stored at 4 °C) and keep it on ice in a laminar flow cabinet. Invert the tube to mix, then add 50–100 µL of extract to each well of a 96‑well plate placed on ice. Gently swirl the plate so the gel spreads evenly. Transfer the plate to a 37 °C cell‑culture incubator and let it gel for 30 min without disturbing it. If air bubbles appear, centrifuge the plate at 300 g for 10 min at 4 °C (pre‑cool the centrifuge to 4 °C) to remove them.

steps.title: Prepare control and treatment media
steps.instruction: For each well prepare 50 µL of the following media: • Blank: DMEM 1X + 0.5 % fetal bovine serum (FBS) + antibiotic‑antimycotic 1X + sodium pyruvate 1 mM. • Positive control (2× VEGF): same composition plus VEGF 80 ng/mL. • Test treatments (2×): same base medium plus the experimental compound at twice the intended final concentration. Keep all media on ice until use.

steps.title: Dissociate and count cells
steps.instruction: Wash adherent cells with PBS 1X (NaCl 140 mM; KCl 2.7 mM; Na₂HPO₄ 10.1 mM; KH₂PO₄ 1.8 mM; pH 7.4). Add 500 µL of trypsin‑EDTA (Gibco 25200056) and incubate at 37 °C for 5 min until cells detach as single cells with >90 % viability. Neutralize the trypsin by adding DMEM 1X supplemented with 10 % FBS, antibiotic‑antimycotic 1X, and sodium pyruvate 1 mM. Verify single‑cell suspension under a microscope and count cells. Use cells that are 2–3 passages post‑thaw.

steps.title: Seed cells onto coated wells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the counted cells in DMEM 1X containing 0.5 % FBS, antibiotic‑antimycotic 1X, and sodium pyruvate 1 mM (growth‑factor‑free medium). Add 15 000 cells in 50 µL to each well of the gelled basement‑membrane plate to achieve 85–90 % confluence. Gently dispense the cell suspension without touching the gel surface and add it slowly to avoid disrupting the gel.

steps.title: Incubate plate with treatments
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the appropriate control or treatment medium (prepared in step 2) to each well. Place the plate in a humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂ and incubate for 24 h (or until the desired experimental endpoint is reached).

steps.title: Image and quantify vascular tubes
steps.instruction: Using an inverted fluorescence microscope (EVOS H0910‑9031‑000) equipped with a 485 nm excitation / 520 nm emission filter, capture images of each well at 40×, scanning consecutive fields until the entire well area is covered. Have two independent observers count complete endothelial tube structures (closed lumen) in each well, calculate the average count, and record the data in a spreadsheet for later statistical analysis.
